items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: Maya Kennedy and Clarence Hall is in Dave Bartholomew's band

ctx.x: I guess you all are about the last ones that are still…

We are the four original members. And a lot of them are dead and then some of them are in other groups. Other groups. For instance, Maya Kennedy and Clarence Hall is in Dave Bartholomew's band, but they are all original members also.
